# Google Contacts MCP

> A remote MCP server that lets Claude and ChatGPT search, read, create and enrich your Google Contacts, with your consent. Every call goes to Google directly; contacts are never stored. Open source, written in Go.

Connector URL to add in an assistant (Claude: Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector; ChatGPT: developer mode, Create app): https://mcp.google-contacts-mcp.samber.dev/mcp

## Pages

- [Home](https://google-contacts-mcp.samber.dev/): what the service does and how to connect it.
- [Privacy policy](https://google-contacts-mcp.samber.dev/privacy): what is stored, what is never stored, and how to erase it.
- [Terms of service](https://google-contacts-mcp.samber.dev/terms): the conditions for using the hosted service.

## Source

- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/samber/google-contacts-mcp): the Go server, the list of tools, self-hosting instructions.
